pass_a_gloss: Because you-will-give to-him blessing into age of-age, you-will-gladden him in joy with the face of-you. Saying toward him: Come, blessed of-the Father of-me. Just-as from the God Father and Lord Jesus Christ this grace and peace is-given, thus from God and the face of-him; face and of-God, the impress of-the hypostasis of-him, with whom the king is-gladdened, a-trial to-the being-expected putting-forward. Or because with the God Word of-the image, of-whom having-become the king, temple of-him he-is-named, and conformed of-him having-become, he-is-gladdened.
pass_b_english: “For you will give him blessing unto age of age; you will gladden him in joy with your face” (Psalm 20:7).

Saying to him: “Come, you blessed of my Father” (Matthew 25:34). Just as this grace and peace is given from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ, so from God and his face; and the face of God is the impress of his hypostasis, with whom the king is gladdened, putting forward a trial for those expected.
Or because with the God-Word of the image, whose the king having become, he is named his temple, and having become conformed to him, he is gladdened.

choices.term: πρόσωπον δὲ Θεοῦ, ὁ χαρακτὴρ τῆς ὑποστάσεως αὐτοῦ
choices.english: the face of God is the impress of his hypostasis
choices.why: Face is the χαρακτήρ of Hebrews 1:3, not a physical countenance only. OCR χα ρακτὴρ.
rejected: the face of God is a physical countenance only
the face is the Father without the Word

choices.term: οὗ γενόμενος ὁ βασιλεὺς, ναὸς αὐτοῦ χρηματίζει
choices.english: whose the king having become, he is named his temple
choices.why: OCR οὐ is οὗ. The king becomes of the image and is named temple. Not ‘the king is not the temple’.
rejected: the king is not the temple
the king becomes God without remainder
